# AeroGlobe: appendix {.page-title}

[Static data pipeline · snapshot notes]{.kicker}

These notes support the [AeroGlobe case study](../aeroglobe.qmd). Pipeline stages and data sources describe the 23 October 2026 snapshot. The built-versus-planned checklist was checked again on 19 November 2026 against the [README at a011ff7](https://github.com/Exios66/aeroglobe/blob/a011ff7b46c0/README.md). They are a scope record, not a live status page.

## Pipeline stages

| Stage | Input | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Normalize | OpenSky state vectors or adsb.lol day files | One record shape |
| Segment | Normalized observations | Per-aircraft tracks and flights |
| Chunk | Flights | Hourly JSON chunks with a size limit |
| Catalog | Chunks | The manifest the browser loads |

## Data sources

| Source | Use | Terms |
| --- | --- | --- |
| OpenSky snapshots | A few real observations for the live demo | OpenSky terms; rate-limited |
| adsb.lol daily files | Full historical days, built on the owner's machine | ODbL, © adsb.lol contributors |
| Generated fixtures | Deterministic offline tests and the labeled sample day | Project code |

A full global day needs about 10 GB of disk and roughly 6 GB of RAM at build time.

## Built versus planned

| Built (README at a011ff7) | Planned, not claimed by that README |
| --- | --- |
| Globe client with search, filters and flight cards | A published real historical day on the live site |
| Playback, track replay and trails | Off-main-thread decoding and a transport bar |
| Static pipeline, catalog and hourly chunks | Inferred routes between airports |
| OpenSky snapshot and fixture commands | — |
| Reference airport, airline and time-zone tables | — |
| Route-pair search over the loaded day's index | — |
| Aircraft history panel | — |
| Time-zone overlay | — |
| In-browser personal logbook | — |

## Snapshot counts

The 23 October 2026 notes recorded 395 passing tests in 42 files and about 5,800 lines of TypeScript, with a clean lint, type-check and production build. A recount on 30 October 2026 found 282 test declarations in 43 files and 8,090 lines of TypeScript. On 26 November 2026 I ran the suite on `main` at `a011ff7`: 451 tests passed in 54 of 56 files; the other two need a time-zone file from a GitHub release that the run could not download.

## Reproduce

```sh
npm install
DATA_SOURCE=fixtures npm run build     # offline, deterministic sample data
npm run build:check
```

The live deployment is built from the `gh-pages` branch; the repository documents the build-time snapshot fallback and the optional data branch.

:::
